en.explanation:
Given,

A2 5A + 7I = 0

   A2 5A = 7I

   AAA1 5AA1 = 7IA1

   AI 5I = 7A1

   A 5I = 7A1

   A1 = (5I A)

Hence, statement 1 is true.

Now A3 2A2 3A + I

=   A(A2) 2A2 3A + I

=   A(5A 7I) 2A2 3A + I

=   5A2 7A 2A2 3A + I

=   3A2 10A + I

=   3(5A 7I) 10A + I

=   15A 21A 10A + I

=   5A 20I

=   5(A 4I)

So, statement 2 is also correct.
